target: Unchanged 25-source/33-state target and teacher-action J; P_future remains the estimand. Inherit the unchanged future T and path mixture G=(P+T)/2.
budget: Retain every inherited action stratum. Equal even counts >=4, total max(256,4*strata). State 8 has 65 strata and gets 260 roots; all other states get 256. All three arms use identical counts/actions/seeds, two independent batches. No outcome-dependent extensions.
measurement: IID selects one P/T component by fair coin per root. Fixed selects exactly half P, half T within every initial-action stratum, with random outcome-blind permutation. Balance weights P/G <=2 occur once in both estimators.
variance: Fixed variance is sum C_h^2*(s_P^2/n_P+s_T^2/n_T)/4, not pooled s^2/n. Also predeclare same-fixed-draw unbiased estimate of the removed between-component term; retain finite negative estimates. True removed term C_h^2*(mu_P-mu_T)^2/(4*n_h) is nonnegative.
uncertainty: Component-mean empirical Bernstein intervals in [0,2], Bonferroni over natural/IID/two fixed components, states/strata/batches. Only the combined fixed mean has known expectation <=1. Structural benefit is not a full-bank precision or source-generalization certificate.
scope: Training estimator development only; no state/action target changes, fitted Q_S, PPO export, validation/test episodes or production mutation. Retain all original and new outcomes.
